_comment: Multi-AI consensus configuration - controls worker count and models

workers._comment_models: Available: opus, sonnet, haiku, gemini (if configured)
workers._comment_count: Set to 1 for single-AI (fast/cheap), 2-3 for consensus, 4+ for maximum quality

arbiter._comment: Arbiter synthesizes worker results. Set enabled=false to skip (saves 1 agent call)

presets._comment: Quick presets - copy a preset to the root level to use it

single-ai._note: Fastest, cheapest - no consensus, just one model

workers-only._note: No arbiter - return all worker results, let caller choose
